title: Mexican student creates an acoustic fire extinguisher to put out fire in seconds
summary: A 16-year-old Mexican student developed an innovative acoustic fire extinguisher that uses low-frequency sound waves to extinguish fires in seconds, presenting a novel approach to fire safety compared to traditional chemical-based extinguishers.
problem_solved: Provides a non-chemical, potentially safer and more accessible alternative to traditional fire extinguishers that require training and use potentially harmful chemicals.
why_valuable: This acoustic approach could democratize fire safety by offering a simpler, potentially more environmentally friendly method to extinguish small fires without toxic chemicals.
